claims: WrestleMania 42 is scheduled for Saturday, April 18, and Sunday, April 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 is scheduled at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada.
WrestleMania 42 will be available for streaming.
Both nights of WrestleMania 42 are expected to begin around 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT.
The location of WrestleMania 42 is Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas (Paradise, Nevada).
WrestleMania 42 streaming/broadcasting includes WWE, ESPN (U.S.), Netflix (International).
Tickets for WrestleMania 42 are available through Ticketmaster, including two-day combos, as noted in the Ticketmaster event listing.
